plans.idea: A centred vertical poster: small logo crowning the page, headline and benefit list as one block, the book cover as a centred showpiece, then the Become a Member button with the price line right under it, all on one central axis.

Product first: a large book cover across the top under a small left-aligned logo, then the headline and benefits in a full-width left-aligned block, ending in a bottom row of the button with the price line beside it.

An asymmetric editorial layout: the logo top-left balances a big cover in the top-right corner, and below it a full-width left-aligned column holds the headline, benefits, button and price line, all on one left edge.
